items.title: The two structure maps of a direct sum are a kernel and a cokernel
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a preadditive category the first injection of a direct sum is a kernel of the second projection, and dually the first projection is a cokernel of the second injection (statement lines 469-477). The proof is a complete argument: for a morphism into the direct sum killed by the projection, the identity of the direct sum decomposed into the two composites exhibits the required factorisation, and uniqueness is read off from the composite of projection and injection (proof lines 479-486); the dual statement follows by duality (proof line 487). The non-formal content is the decomposition of the identity and the factorisation. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
